package invitation // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/invitation"

type State struct {
	Revoked       bool
	ExpiresAt     *time.Time
	Uses, MaxUses int
}

func (s State) Status(now time.Time) Status

type Status string

const (
	Open    Status = "open"
	Revoked Status = "revoked"
	Expired Status = "expired"
	UsedUp  Status = "used up"
)

func (s Status) Label() string
